role: REGIME-TARGETED EXPERIMENT: fixes the SELECTION regime measured on SFT6 (56/75 failures where gold was not candidate-ranked #1). Parent = frozen SFT6 child. NOT an OOD suite; QIM-v4 is its replication instrument.
hypothesis: Adding a same-fact-block competitor margin to the group CE objective converts SFT6's selection misses (gold not ranked #1) into correct selections, without degrading realization, extraction, or protected capabilities.

parent.note: SFT6 is the parent because ITS measured selection misses are the target; this is the first second-generation intervention and lineage records it as such.

design.objective: L_unit = mean_m CE_m + margin_weight * mean_m [ sum_c clamp(gamma - (lp(g_m) - lp(c)), 0) / |C_m| ] where lp are DIFFERENTIABLE full-sequence completion logprobs and C_m = other codes in m's own fact block
design.data: data/grouped_queryswap train split (unchanged files, hashes below)

context_value_extraction_v2.note: CVE-v2 was built AFTER SFT6 per P10; it becomes a LIVE gate for the first time here, with baselines recorded before this proposal was written

protection_floors_preregistered.protected_capability_families: single_fact / tool_result / copy / protocol_transfer each >= own parent baseline - 0.10 (parent = SFT6)

replication_instrument.vocab_disjointness: programmatically verified at build time (prefix_hits=[], entity_hits=[])
replication_instrument.usage: parent baseline BEFORE training; selected child evaluated ONCE after freeze; never used for selection

pre_registered_predictions.PR1_selection_rank_v4: On QIM-v4, child correct-rank-1 fraction > parent by >= +8 candidates of 119 (~+7%) — direct test that selection misses convert
pre_registered_predictions.PR2_lift_preserved_v4: Child mean group lift >= parent mean group lift - 0.3 nats (the margin must not buy rank by destroying lift)
pre_registered_predictions.PR3_greedy_v4: Child greedy corresponding accuracy > parent greedy accuracy on QIM-v4 (directional)
pre_registered_predictions.PR4_realization_not_harmed: Constrained-decode realization check on QIM-v4 failures: child free-greedy success among candidate-rank-1 items does not fall below parent's 44/63 rate minus 5 items
pre_registered_predictions.PR6_protected_retention: every protected family >= own SFT6 baseline - 0.10

falsification_rules.SUCCESS_FULL: PR1+PR3 pass and floors hold => margin objective converts selection misses behaviorally; next step is fresh-suite behavioral replication
falsification_rules.PARTIAL_RANK_ONLY: PR1 passes but PR3 fails => latent selection improved, decode still dominated; decode-commitment pressure becomes the justified next lever
falsification_rules.FAILURE: PR1 fails or any floor breaks => reject the margin hypothesis for this regime; do not iterate gamma/weight without a new preregistration

evaluation_discipline: train with trajectory evals; select on DEVELOPMENT metrics only
freeze selected child; evaluate ONCE on QIM-v4 paired vs parent
no retraining or re-selection based on QIM-v4 numbers
verified_intervention_experiences_note: training experiment; earns no VIE credit regardless of outcome
